died.name: Agrippa d'Aubigné
died.desc: French poet, soldier, propagandist and chronicler
died.last_words: It comes at last, the happy day: Let thanks be given to God in heaven, while we learn pleasure in His way.

died.name: George Farquhar
died.last_words: Dear Bob, I have nothing to leave thee to perpetuate my memory but two helpless girls. Look upon them sometimes, and think of him who was to the last moment of his life thine, George Farquhar.

died.name: Louis Petit de Bachaumont
died.last_words: The priest could never draw another thing from dying but 'Dear Sir, you are so kind.'

died.name: Ludwig Wittgenstein
died.cause: upon being told that his close friends would come to visit him the next day
died.last_words: Tell them I've had a wonderful life.

died.name: Alfred Hitchcock
died.last_words: One never knows the ending. One has to die to know exactly what happens after death, although Catholics have their hopes.

born.name: Nicholas Comper
born.cause: dying in hospital after being knocked down while lighting a firework in Hythe, Kent, by a passer-by to whom he claimed he was an IRA man planning to blow up the town hall The 42-year-old aviator and aircraft designer was attempting to light a firework in Hythe, Kent, when a passerby enquired what he was doing; he replied sarcastically that he was an IRA man planning to blow up the town hall. The passerby responded by knocking down Comper, who hit his head on the curb.
born.last_words: I didn't know prisons had such comfortable beds.

born.name: Emperor Hirohito of Japan,
born.cause: a last message to Shoichi Fujimori, commissioner of Imperial Household Agency
born.last_words: I believe that the image of walking through, these turbulent times live on people's hearts for a long time.
